name: msc-built-in-ai-embedding
description: <msc-built-in-ai-embedding /> is a web component based on Chrome Built-in AI Semantic Embedder API. Web developers could use <msc-built-in-ai-embedding /> to generate vector embeddings with EmbeddingGemma and provide vivid features like semantic search or text similarity comparison. <msc-built-in-ai-embedding /> is a non-UI component. But it will provide current status in data-status. That means web developers have maximum creation to build UI through this information.
author: Paul Li
